description: This file defines a React component for managing and displaying user sessions in a modal dialog. It includes hooks for retrieving, revoking, and refreshing sessions, and renders a modal interface with session details and revocation controls.

methods.name: useSessions
methods.description: A custom React hook that manages fetching, revoking, and updating user sessions from the application.

methods.name: SessionsModalContent
methods.description: React component rendering the modal content for managing sessions, including session list, refresh, revoke, and confirmation dialogs.

methods.name: SessionsModal
methods.description: Main React component wrapping the modal overlay and embedding SessionsModalContent, managing modal visibility.
